items.quote: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
items.claim: The children of Israel executed the LORD's commands relayed through Moses, pitching camp by their standards and advancing according to their family lineages
items.action: pitched by their standards, and set forward
items.mechanism: according to their families, according to the house of their fathers
